verdict.rationale: Reflect has a real OAuth2/PKCE REST API with a published OpenAPI spec, but the vendor says it only covers appending to notes, creating notes, and listing/creating bookmarked links, plus 'a few other things'. Because of end-to-end encryption, the docs state outright that the servers 'can't serve [note contents] up in the API', so UI parity is far out of reach. Missing for 10: reading or listing note contents, search and semantic search, AI palette and chat, note history and revert, publishing, tags and backlinks, calendar and integrations, audio transcription, import/export, and any versioning or sandbox.
